# Enteha Group (گروه فنی مهندسی انتها)

> Enteha Group (گروه فنی مهندسی انتها) is a mechanical engineering design-and-build group based in Tehran and Isfahan, Iran; it is not related to other businesses that use the word “Enteha” (انتها, “end”) in their names. It designs and builds special-purpose machines, test rigs and industrial robots, automates production lines, and manufactures industrial parts to drawing, for clients across Iran. One-off orders are accepted and quotes are free (usually within 1–2 weeks).

> گروه فنی مهندسی انتها یک گروه طراحی و ساخت مهندسی مکانیک در تهران و اصفهان است و با کسب‌وکارهای دیگری که واژه‌ی «انتها» در نامشان است ارتباطی ندارد.

## Key facts

- Based in Tehran and Isfahan, Iran; serves clients across Iran. Website: https://entehagroup.ir/
- Core team: Hassan Nasiri Khonsari (Technical & Design Director), Alireza Pirhaji (Manufacturing & Quality Lead), Seyed Mostafa Banihashemi (Project & R&D Lead); degrees from Sharif University of Technology, IUST, K. N. Toosi University and Tarbiat Modares University; plus a network of partner workshops and specialists.
- Scope: requirements, concept and detailed design, engineering analysis (FEA), fabrication, assembly, quality control and commissioning. The engineer who designs a machine also supervises its fabrication and assembly.
- Track record: 80 postal sorting robots built for Iran Post (50 for Tehran, 30 for Kermanshah, 2020–2025), with a third-generation design produced as a 200-unit series; a 6-DOF knee prosthesis test rig to ASTM F1223, the first of its kind in Iran (2021); five industrial FDM 3D printers up to 500 × 500 × 400 mm (2020–2023); a fleet of seven waiter robots (2021); a dual-purpose CNC with a ~100 × 100 cm bed (2023).
- Past work ranges from machines of 10–250 kg to structures of about 1–2 tonnes.
- Typical timelines: 1–2 weeks to about a year; a simple special-purpose machine takes 1–2 months of design and 1–2 months of fabrication. Quotes are free and take 1–2 weeks.
- Automation: Delta and Siemens PLC, HMI, servo and stepper motion control, weighing and measurement, control cabinets, integration with existing equipment.
- Parts: CNC machining, laser cutting, bending and rolling, welded structures in steel and 316 stainless, pressure vessels and enclosures, plastic injection moulds, dimensional and weld inspection (GD&T), reverse engineering; drawings accepted in any format.
- Support: faults in machines Enteha designed and built are fixed for 2 months after delivery; longer warranty, repairs and upgrades by contract.
- Industries: medical and dental devices, postal and logistics, additive manufacturing, universities and research centres, service robotics.
- Awards: Laureate, 64th Alborz Elite Prize (2026); 2nd place, 26th Khwarizmi Youth Festival (2024); 2nd place, 24th Khwarizmi Youth Festival (2022); best design, 4th Iran Industrial Design Festival (2024); top startup, Sharif Science & Technology Park (2024).
- Publication: “Frictional behavior between bone and additively manufactured Ti6Al4V implants is affected by bone density and surface texture under varying loads”, Scientific Reports, 2025 (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-025-25586-0).

## Projects

- [Postal sorting robots](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/postal-sorting-robots.html): 80 autonomous parcel-sorting robots built for Iran Post; the third-generation design went into production as a 200-unit series.
- [Knee prosthesis constraint & stability test rig](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/knee-prosthesis-test-rig.html): A six-degree-of-freedom test rig for total knee prostheses to ASTM F1223 — the first of its kind in Iran.
- [DMD powder feeder](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/dmd-powder-feeder.html): A powder feeder for laser direct metal deposition, controlling the feed rate between 1 and 100 g/min.
- [Industrial FDM 3D printers](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/industrial-3d-printers.html): Five FDM printers designed and built from scratch, up to an industrial machine with a 500 × 500 × 400 mm build volume.
- [Rail-guided platform over a test pool](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/rail-guided-test-platform.html): A rail-guided platform and cabin over a water-treatment test pool: structural design, fabrication and on-site installation.
- [Cable-driven rehabilitation robot](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/cable-rehabilitation-robot.html): A cable-driven robot to improve postural alignment in children with cerebral palsy: design, fabrication and control.
- [Waiter robots](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/waiter-robots.html): A fleet of seven food delivery and serving robots that stay stable on uneven restaurant floors.
- [Dual-purpose industrial CNC](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/dual-purpose-cnc.html): A modular CNC with a bed of about 100 × 100 cm for wood and light metals that becomes a 3D printer with a head swap.
- [Dental aligners & veneers](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/dental-aligners.html): Orthodontic aligners and removable dental veneers produced by resin (DLP) 3D printing.
- [Conveyor-belt FDM 3D printer](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/conveyor-3d-printer.html): An FDM printer with a conveyor-belt bed for continuous printing of long parts and batches.
- [Plastic injection mould](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/injection-mould.html): Design and machining of a plastic injection mould.
- [Jet engine cutaway model](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/jet-engine-model.html): A 3D-printed cutaway model of a jet engine for display and teaching.
- [Cable-driven drawing robot](https://entehagroup.ir/projects/cable-drawing-robot.html): A cable-driven drawing robot that turns any photo into a line drawing and draws it on canvas.
